data.Q: Why is the place west of Kiriath Jearim given that name?
data.A: Because the Danites set up camp there.
data.wrong_answer: Because the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol.

data.Q: From what place do the Danites go on to the hill country?
data.A: From the camp near Kiriath Jearim.

data.Q: What do the Danites reach after the hill country of Ephraim?
Where do the Danites set up camp in relation to Kiriath Jearim?
What do the Danites do on the way before they reach the hill country?
data.A: They set up camp near Kiriath Jearim.
